areas.name: Archival Cabinet Route
areas.location_cue: The original Daiichi cabinet, model plate, playfield, panel, mechanisms, controls, and service record.
areas.note: Use lawful private non-wager free play. Specification variants are documented separately, not replayed.

save_backup.title: Preserve the cabinet state first
save_backup.why: Rare presentations and service settings may not reproduce.

levels.1: The selected route is the first cabinet release.
levels.2: Use an authentic 2015 Daiichi CR Biohazard 0 machine.
levels.3: Before play, verify its model plate, cabinet artwork, playfield, control panel, mechanisms, software identity, and service record. Do not substitute a later specification variant.

levels.1: Several cabinets reuse the presentation with altered specifications.
levels.2: Keep Sweet, Light Middle, and MAX records outside this route.
levels.3: Photograph each encountered model plate. Complete the original route once; archive a variant only as comparative evidence and never merge its probability, round, or support figures.

levels.1: Archival completion never requires a wager.
levels.2: Use a lawfully owned machine configured for free play.
levels.3: Have an authorized owner prepare the cabinet from its operator documentation. Do not deposit money, pursue payouts, bypass certified safety hardware, or use public gambling to reveal content.

levels.1: The screen and physical cabinet perform together.
levels.2: Record the entire cabinet in one synchronized view.
levels.3: Start before power-on and preserve an uncut master showing controls, ball path, display, Touch Vision, moving parts, lamps, speakers, counters, result screens, and resets.

levels.1: Internal setup can alter observed behaviour.
levels.2: Photograph authorized settings and counters before play.
levels.3: Record model, firmware, free-play hardware, visible counters, date, initial state, and every authorized configuration change. Restore the starting setup after capture.
